topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Evolution and Microenvironmental Factors
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the learning objectives and thematic framework of the lecture regarding cancer evolution, cell origin, and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Clonal Selection and Epigenetic Mechanisms in Early Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cellular mutations and epigenetic modifications confer selective growth advantages to drive clonal expansion.

topics.label: Stem Cell Hierarchies and the Cell of Origin in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tissue hierarchies and stemness properties influence cancer initiation and tumor-propagating potential across tissue models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Signals and Stromal Support in Tumor Development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how inflammatory signals and supportive stromal microenvironments are essential for promoting and maintaining malignant growth.

topics.label: Methodologies for Investigating Cancer Evolution and Spatial Microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines experimental, sequencing, and spatial omics technologies used to map cellular interactions and trace evolutionary trajectories in tumors.

topics.label: Multifactorial Synthesis of Cancer Evolution and Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics integrate the intersecting roles of genetics, epigenetics, cell identity, and microenvironment into a unified evolutionary framework and close the lecture.
